description: OpenVerify nickname table (plan C58.3). Each pair links a formal given name and one of its nicknames; the matcher never chains pairs. Generated by packages/checks/scripts/build-nicknames.ts from nicknames-authored.tsv (our own rows) and nicknames-wikidata.tsv (Wikidata pairs a reviewer accepted); edit those files, never this one.
